ExDoc is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2024 to 2025.

What it was for: [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [distance-calculator](@/work/distance-calculator.md); [job-processor](@/work/job-processor.md): This is a simple web service built with Elixir, Plug, and Cowboy that processes job tasks with dependencies and generates execution order and bash scripts.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses ExDoc: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links ExDoc to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
